jobs.title: Business Operations Analyst
jobs.why: Strong fit for Audrey's operational reporting, Excel analysis, discrepancy investigations, stakeholder interviews, process improvement, and cross-functional Salesforce/ABA systems work. Employer describes KPI definition, process playbooks, payment-data analysis, customer interviews and collaboration with Engineering. Open to 1–3 years of analytical work and explicitly says SQL can be learned on the job.
jobs.gap: No direct ownership of growth experiments, payment analytics, or sales funnel strategy; SQL coursework does not establish independent production querying.

jobs.title: GTM Business Systems Analyst – Post Sales
jobs.why: Audrey's Salesforce Flow automation, page layouts and validation rules, data governance, Legal/Finance stakeholder requirements, UAT, training, and documentation align with this hands-on post-sales systems role. Employer lists 3+ years in sales/revenue operations or business systems and Salesforce Administrator certification or equivalent experience.
jobs.gap: Deep hands-on LeanData, Outreach, Chili Piper, Workato, Hightouch and other GTM-stack administration is not established. Independent end-to-end integrations and post-sales revenue systems ownership are also unproven; high compensation reflects a stretch role.

jobs.title: Operations Analyst
jobs.why: Employer seeks 2+ years of operations or related experience, analytical problem solving, process improvement, documentation, AI-assisted data analysis, and cross-functional work. Audrey's recurring finance reporting QA, investigations, CRM data integrity audits, Excel and stakeholder coordination fit the analytical and operational aspects.
jobs.gap: Role includes reviewing suspicious payout activity and making compliance/risk decisions; Audrey has not demonstrated payments fraud investigations, regulatory compliance decisions, or transaction approval authority. Only $5K of base range exceeds $100K.

jobs.title: Customer Success Enablement Specialist
jobs.location: New York City metropolitan area — hybrid (Midtown Manhattan, 3 days/week)
jobs.why: Adjacent operations/enablement role: Audrey delivered Salesforce stakeholder training to 90+ users, created Scribe guides and Salesforce Knowledge documentation, coordinated UAT and cross-functional process changes. The role creates product enablement materials, maintains an internal resource hub, coordinates with Product/Operations, and measures program effectiveness.
jobs.gap: Employer requests 3–5 years of dedicated SaaS customer-success enablement/training, instructional design, LMS use, renewal/adoption knowledge and customer lifecycle metrics; these are not established at that depth. Travel 10–25%, and $100K is the salary ceiling.
missingKeywords: dedicated SaaS customer success enablement tenure
